mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have partly cloudy skies and a temperature of 65 degrees at Verona City Hall, with a new moon overhead.

In city news, the Common Council has adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This long-range document, developed with extensive public input, will steer local growth, neighborhood development, and infrastructure for years to come.
Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking toward tomorrow, local favorites like Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company are hosting trivia nights.
Regarding the weekly police report, on September 28, officers responded to a collision at Enterprise Drive and East Verona Avenue involving a juvenile operating an eMoto recklessly.
Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM and will serve customers until 10:00 PM tonight.
